question: When the tribes of Joseph attacked Bethel, what happened to the man who showed their spies how to get into the city?
options: He was made king of Bethel
He and his whole family were spared
He was taken as a prisoner to Shiloh
He joined the tribe of Ephraim
explanation: The spies promised to treat the man well if he showed them the way in. They kept their word and spared him and his whole family.
